Title: Remote file sharing
Subtitle: Connect to a peer and send files after approval.
RoomLabel: Shared room name · match your peer
NetworkHint: Leave blank to connect only within the same network. With a STUN server, the address this PC has outside its router is also used to try direct connections across networks. No relay server is used.
Instructions: The receiver should connect using Wait for connection first. Then the sender connects using Start connection.
ApprovalHint: Transfer starts after the peer chooses a save location and approves.
Ready: Connect to a peer to send and receive files.
InvalidServer: Enter a signaling server URL starting with ws:// or wss://.
InvalidIds: Enter different local and peer device IDs and a shared room ID. (Up to 128 characters.)
InvalidStun: Enter valid stun:server:port URLs, one per line.
SessionClosed: The connection closed. Disconnect, then reconnect to try again.
OfferReceived: Your peer wants to send a file. Choose a save location or reject it.
PeerWaiting: Waiting for the peer to initiate a connection.
ConnectionReady: Connected. Either peer can send files. Route: {0}
ConnectionTimeout: Connection timed out. Check the signaling server and whether the peer addresses are directly reachable.
ChooseDialog: Choose a file to send remotely
Sent: The peer saved the file and verified its SHA-256 hash.
CanceledStatus: The transfer was canceled or the connection closed.
SaveDialog: Choose where to save the incoming file
NoOverwrite: Choose a new filename to preserve the existing file.
TestHint: Connect the test window first, then connect this window. The signaling server must be running.
Error.transfer-busy: Another file transfer is in progress.
Error.offer-expired: The incoming file request has expired.
Error.destination-exists: A file with that name already exists. Choose a different name.
Error.receive-open-failed: The peer could not open its destination file.
Error.receiver-canceled: The receiver rejected or canceled the transfer.
Error.receive-failed: The peer could not save or verify the file.
Error.peer-busy: The peer is transferring another file.
Error.Timeout: The peer did not respond in time.
Error.Network: Could not connect to the server or peer. Check the address and network settings.
Error.File: Could not read or save the file. Check the path and access permissions.
Error.Protocol: Transfer verification failed. Reconnect and try again.
Error.Unexpected: The operation could not be completed. Reconnect and try again.
IceHint: host = this PC's network address, srflx = address seen outside the router (STUN or TURN), relay = TURN. Connect both peers to inspect the selected pair. Reports contain candidate IP addresses.
IceGathered: Gathering complete. Check relay candidates for TURN; gathering alone does not prove peer connectivity.
IceGatherTimeout: Gathering stopped or timed out. Partial candidates are retained.
IceConnectionFailed: Connection failed. Check signaling and ICE diagnostics.
TurnHint: Enter the relay server address and login details you received. Login details are not saved to a file. If they expire, get new details and reconnect.
RelayOnly: Always use the relay (allow direct connections when off)
InvalidTurn: Enter valid turn: or turns: URLs, one per line, optionally with ?transport=udp or ?transport=tcp.
MissingTurnCredentials: Enter the relay server login and password.
RelayNeedsTurn: Choose TURN and enter its connection details.
ConnectionMethod: How would you like to connect?
TurnApiUrl: Credential endpoint (leave blank to use the connection server)
AutoTurnHint: Connection details are requested with your signed-in account. Each connection or environment check requests fresh credentials. Remote endpoints require HTTPS.
TurnFetching: Getting temporary connection details from the server.
Error.turn-https-required: Use https:// for remote credential servers. HTTP is allowed only on this PC.
Error.turn-unauthorized: Your sign-in has expired or access was denied. Please sign in again.
Error.turn-not-configured: The credential server has no Cloudflare connection settings.
Error.turn-rate-limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and retry.
Error.turn-upstream-failed: The credential server could not obtain credentials from Cloudflare. Check its configuration.
Error.turn-invalid-response: The credential server did not return valid relay credentials.
Error.turn-expired: The issued credentials have expired. Reconnect to obtain new ones.
Error.turn-unreachable: Cannot reach the credential server. Check its address and your network.
Error.turn-cloudflare-auth: Cloudflare rejected the API token. Check its permissions and the matching TURN Token ID on the server.
Error.turn-cloudflare-key-not-found: Cloudflare could not find the TURN key. Check the server TURN Token ID.
Error.turn-cloudflare-rate-limited: Cloudflare limited credential issuance. Wait and retry.
Error.turn-cloudflare-invalid-response: Cloudflare returned an invalid credential response.
Error.turn-cloudflare-unreachable: The credential server cannot reach Cloudflare. Check its internet, DNS and HTTPS access.
Error.turn-endpoint-not-found: The credential API path was not found. Leave the endpoint blank, check the connection server address, and restart the server with the latest code.
Error.turn-server-unavailable: The tunnel or credential server is unavailable. Check both server terminals and the current tunnel address.
